main_body: A flat green grass ground patch (about 36x16 px) with scattered darker grass tufts and a few small pink and yellow flower clusters; no standing volume.
top_band: none - ground terrain with no top/front structure; a single column shows varying greens only
evidence: This is a flat terrain tile. It is a grass ground texture with tufts and flower dots, with no standing body, so the 3/4 top and front structure does not apply. It is not a front elevation, side elevation or top-down object slab. Terrain kind is accepted as a flat surface with no volume to judge, so no 3/4 fault is found.

style.evidence: The grass uses roughly 4 greens: a mid base, a lighter tuft tone, a darker tuft tone and a deep green. It has scattered 2-3px tufts and flower accents, with no outlines, which suits ground. Against the Beodeul grass reference, which has larger clumps, a dark-green patch and more varied tufts, the candidate looks a little sparser and more uniform: many areas are mid-green with only a single-pixel speckle, and the flowers are few. It is not flat and has no sticker look, but it is slightly thinner than the reference, and when in doubt it fails.
